instructions.name: buy
docs: Buy `n` floors. `max_cost` protects against the price moving under you.

instructions.name: buyback_damm
docs: Keeper-only: same as `buyback_dbc`, against the migrated DAMM v2 pool.

instructions.name: buyback_dbc
docs: Keeper-only: swap up to `buyback.max_lamports` of harvested SOL for the game token
on the bonding curve. `min_out` comes from an off-chain quote; together with the
size cap and the cooldown it bounds what a sandwich attack can extract.

instructions.name: claim_dividends
docs: Withdraw accrued dividends for a round (works during or after the round).

instructions.name: claim_jackpot
docs: The last buyer of a settled round withdraws the jackpot.

accounts.name: winner_token_account
docs: Anyone may crank this, but funds only ever go to the winner's token account.

instructions.name: harvest_damm
docs: Permissionless, after migration: claim fees from one of the treasury's locked
DAMM v2 LP positions. DAMM checks that the treasury owns the position NFT.

instructions.name: harvest_dbc
docs: Permissionless: claim the treasury's partner + creator trading fees from the DBC
pool. Fees are collected in SOL (QuoteToken mode) into the treasury's WSOL account.

instructions.name: harvest_dbc_surplus
docs: Permissionless, once the curve has completed: claim the partner and creator share
of the surplus SOL left over from the final buy. Each side can only claim once.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Binds the game to a token that was launched on DBC with the treasury PDA as both
fee claimer and pool creator. Launch order (see scripts/launch.ts):
pre-generate the mint keypair → derive game + treasury → create DBC config with
fee_claimer = treasury → create pool → transfer_pool_creator(treasury) → initialize.

accounts.name: wsol_vault
docs: Harvested SOL fees waiting to be spent on buybacks.

accounts.name: stash
docs: Buyback output lands here before it is split.

instructions.name: set_authority
docs: Hand admin rights to another key (e.g. a multisig). Passing `Pubkey::default()`
renounces them for good: nobody can sign as it, so keeper and buyback limits freeze.

instructions.name: set_damm_config
docs: Fix the DAMM v2 config if the migration used a different one than expected.
Only allowed before the DBC pool has migrated, so it can't redirect live buybacks.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Permissionless: anyone can close out an expired round and open the next one.

errors.name: WrongPool
errors.msg: Pool or config does not belong to this game's token

errors.name: TreasuryNotCreator
errors.msg: Treasury PDA must be the DBC pool creator

errors.name: TreasuryNotFeeClaimer
errors.msg: Treasury PDA must be the DBC config fee claimer

errors.name: NotKeeper
errors.msg: Only the keeper can buy back

fields.name: keeper
docs: The only key allowed to call `buyback_*` (it supplies the `min_out` quote).

fields.name: max_lamports
docs: Max SOL (lamports) per buyback call.

fields.name: min_gap_secs
docs: Minimum seconds between buybacks.

fields.name: damm_config
docs: DAMM v2 config the DBC pool migrates into; determines the DAMM pool address.
